newsitem.title: UK: Mercury sells a mln Northern shares.
newsitem.headline: Mercury sells a mln Northern shares.

text.p: Mercury Asset Management Group Plc said on Tuesday it had sold just over one million shares in Northern electric on Monday, reducing its stake in the British electricity supplier to 1.78 percent.
It said it sold 820,000 shares at 630p and 250,000 shares at 645p, leaving it with 1.81 million Northern Electric shares.
Northern rejected a $1.225 billion bid from Nebraska-based CE Electric launched on Monday at 630p a share.
CE snapped up 12.72 percent of Northern in the market on Monday at 630p a share.

Sun Life Investment Management Ltd announced that it sold a parcel of 40,460 Northern Electric shares and a block of 302,683 on Monday at 636p and 645p respectively, which has left it with a 2.55 percent holding in the company.
BP Pensions Services Ltd said it had sold 100,000 at 647p on Monday and 650,000 on Tuesday at 630p, leaving it with a 0.5 percent holding.
